'''Nicholas Vince''' is an actor and writer who played the [[Cenobite]] [[Chatterer I|Chatterer]] in ''[[Hellraiser (1987 film)|Hellraiser]]'', and {{h2}}.

==Acting==
Following ''Hellbound'', Vince portrayed Kinski in the 1990 film ''Nightbreed'' which, like ''Hellraiser'', was written and directed by [[Clive Barker]], and also starred [[Doug Bradley]].

In 2018 he voiced two characters in the audio drama adaptation of ''[[The Hellbound Heart (audio drama)|The Hellbound Heart]]'', "Businessman" and "Cenobite 4".

==Writing==
As well as two volumes of his own original horror fiction, Vince has written two short stories set within the ''[[Hellraiser (Franchise)|Hellraiser]]'' franchise: "[[Look, See...]]" was published in issue #7 of FEAR magazine in 1989, and "[[Demon's Design]]" in the 2009 anthology ''[[Hellbound Hearts]]''.

Vince has also written a number of ''Hellraiser'' and ''Nightbreed'' comics, including "[[Cenobite!]]", and [[Prayers of Desire]]".

==Documentaries==
Additionally, Vince has been interviewed for documentaries such as ''[[Leviathan: The Story of Hellraiser and Hellbound: Hellraiser II]]'' and ''[[Hell on Earth: The Story of Hellraiser III]]''.

'''Simon Bamford''' is the actor who played [[Butterball]] in {{h1}} and {{h2}}.

He also appears in [[Clive Barker]]'s 1990 film ''Nightbreed'', playing the character of Ohnaka.

Additionally, Bamford was Barker's inspiration for Simon McNeal, when Barker was writing ''The Books of Blood''. Bamford would later appear in the 2009  film adaptation, in the role of Derek.

He has been interviewed, over the years, for a number of ''Hellraiser'' related documentaries.
